lines.name: Marcus Oyelaran
lines.content: United Material Handling, this is Marcus.

lines.name: Sandra Kelleher
lines.content: Marcus, the pallet jacks were supposed to be here Tuesday. It is Thursday. This is unacceptable and I want to speak to a manager.

lines.name: Marcus Oyelaran
lines.content: I understand, and I am sorry. Let me pull up the order before I hand you to anyone so you are not repeating yourself.

lines.name: Sandra Kelleher
lines.content: Fine. But if this happens again we will take my business elsewhere.

lines.name: Marcus Oyelaran
lines.content: That is fair. The freight carrier had them sitting in Louisville. I can have it delivered by Monday morning and I am getting Rick on the line now.
